$comment: This app, as Fact Explorer sees it. The descriptor lives here rather than in Fact Explorer so
the values sit beside the Main.scala they mirror (appId, basePath, storagePrefix) and move with
the app if it is ever extracted. Fact Explorer's scripts/build-registry.mjs globs
../*/fact-explorer.app.json and merges every one it finds into public/data/apps.json — so this
file IS the registration, and there is nothing to add to a list anywhere else.
Keep in step with src/main/scala/gov/irs/creditassistant/Main.scala and this repo's Makefile PORT.
label: Credit Assistant
